review_type: Assistant visual inspection of generated raster figures; not independent field control or a numerical registration RMSE
observations: The NW escarpment and branching elevated structures in the image correspond to the hillshade and closely spaced DEM contours.
The central and eastern circular depressions correspond to closed low-elevation contours at the same broad positions.
The isolated SW elevated feature corresponds to closed high-elevation contours and local steep slopes; image saturation/invalid neighbours are excluded.
The five distributed 512 m windows show consistent broad terrain structures; fine image texture and physical shadow boundaries are not reproduced exactly by the stereo DEM.
conclusion: No gross relative displacement was apparent in the reviewed area. Sufficient spatial compatibility for a prototype using the official PDS-labelled grid and a 10 m route mesh.
limits: No independent ground control, external accuracy estimate or subpixel alignment measurement.
Synthetic hillshade illumination differs from the observation illumination.
Black zero pixels in the detail hillshade windows may be NoData; the overview and contour overlay mark joint-invalid pixels pink.
This is not route or EVA safety validation.
